capabilities.name: Legal register structural validation
capabilities.description: Validates source-linked legal and regulatory monitoring records, dates, status taxonomy and review metadata.
limitations: Does not determine whether any law applies or interpret legal effect.

capabilities.name: Compliance control catalogue validation
capabilities.description: Validates control definitions and references to legal register records.
limitations: Catalogue entries are proposed and not implemented controls.

capabilities.name: Evidence index and gap tracker validation
capabilities.description: Validates evidence metadata, collected-versus-not-collected status, digest format, access class and control references.
limitations: The tracker contains 11 evidence-gap records and zero collected evidence artifacts; gap records are not proof.

explicit_non_capabilities: Legal advice or legal applicability determinations
Security, privacy or AI risk controls enforcement
